name: Spring Awakening
tagline: Tender shoots, crisp radishes & wild alliums
climateDescription: Cool mornings, gentle rain showers, and the first vibrant push of tender green leaves and shoots.
chefTip: Gently blanch spring greens for under 90 seconds to lock in bright chlorophyll and crisp sweetness.
quote: Spring is nature’s way of saying: let’s start fresh.

name: Summer Bounty
tagline: Sun-ripened nightshades, juicy stone fruits & lush herbs
climateDescription: Long sun-drenched afternoons, maximum solar energy, rich sugars accumulating in vine-ripened produce.
chefTip: Never refrigerate warm heirloom tomatoes—keep them on the countertop to retain volatile aromatic esters.
quote: Summer is a feast of color, aroma, and vitality.

name: Autumn Harvest
tagline: Dense squashes, crisp orchard apples & forest fungi
climateDescription: Crisp morning frosts that concentrate sugars in cold-hardy brassicas and deep root vegetables.
chefTip: Roast winter squashes with skin on; heirloom varieties like Delicata develop deeply caramelized edges.
quote: Autumn is the golden treasury of the grower's year.

name: Winter Cellar
tagline: Frost-kissed kales, citrus groves & hearty roots
climateDescription: Chilly weather that triggers starches to convert to natural protective sugars inside hardy greens and roots.
chefTip: Massage lacinato kale with a pinch of sea salt and lemon juice 10 minutes prior to serving to soften cell walls.
quote: Winter nurtures quiet strength and concentrated sweetness.
